sections.description: Lower-level section near the stage on the right side. Close to the performers with a clear view into the room.

Lower-level left-center section. A closer view with a broad look across the stage and aerial space.

One of our sweet-spot sections. Upper left-center gives you a broad look at the full stage and the aerial space above it.
